2607.28271.title: Agentic Method for Deterministic Validation of Legacy Code Migration
2607.28271.paper_summary: Migration of legacy COBOL programs to Java requires extensive testing to ensure correct functionality. This effort is often complicated by the lack of test data and the difficulty of validating all corner cases. In this paper we propose a novel agentic test-synthesis method, the "Locksmith Loop," which is initiated by preparing two runtime environments: the COBOL source and the generated Java target are each instrumented with mocks and executed off-mainframe on commodity hardware, then an iterative agentic loop performs Witness Search over input mocks to penetrate program branches, followed by parity-preserving mutations. When routing boundaries are reached, an analyzer identifies a Locked Paragraph: a condition preventing deeper exploration. Across three COBOL-Java case studies, spanning two open-source programs and one internal production-like COBOL program and ranging from 430 to 4,114 source lines, Locksmith consistently improved coverage beyond input-search plateaus, reaching nearly complete coverage on the two open-source programs and 91.90% branch coverage on the internal production-like COBOL program. The generated Java matched the COBOL reference under deterministic parity checks in all accepted test cases. Through these findings we demonstrate, to the best of our knowledge, a novel approach for validating agentic coding output using a deterministic oracle.
2607.28271.paper_summary_zh: 遺留 COBOL 程式遷移到 Java 需要廣泛的測試以確保正確的功能。這項工作通常因缺乏測試數據和驗證所有邊界情況的困難而變得複雜。在本文中，我們提出了一種新穎的代理測試合成方法，即「鎖匠迴圈」，該方法通過準備兩個運行時環境來啟動：COBOL 源碼和生成的 Java 目標各自用模擬物進行工具化，並在商品硬體上離主機執行，然後一個迭代的代理迴圈對輸入模擬物執行見證搜索，以滲透程式分支，隨後進行保持奇偶性的變異。當路由邊界被達到時，分析器識別出一個鎖定段落：這是一種阻止更深入探索的條件。在三個 COBOL-Java 案例研究中，涵蓋了兩個開源程式和一個內部生產類似的 COBOL 程式，源代碼行數範圍從 430 到 4,114，鎖匠方法始終改善了超越輸入搜索平臺的覆蓋率，在兩個開源程式上達到了幾乎完整的覆蓋率，而在內部生產類似的 COBOL 程式上達到了 91.90% 的分支覆蓋率。生成的 Java 在所有接受的測試案例中，根據確定性奇偶檢查與 COBOL 參考相匹配。通過這些發現，我們展示了據我們所知，使用確定性神諭驗證代理編碼輸出的新穎方法。
